definitions.text_mt: Fosforu: Element kimiku mhux metalliku li jinsab f'diversi forom allotropiċi u huwa essenzjali għall-organiżmi ħajjin.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fosforu huwa essenzjali għall-għadam u s-snien tal-bniedem.
usage_examples.text_en: Phosphorus is essential for human bones and teeth.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fosforu jixgħel meta jiġi f'kuntatt mal-arja.
usage_examples.text_en: Phosphorus ignites when it comes into contact with air.

definitions.text_mt: Fosfru: Ortografija alternattiva ta' fosforu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Fosfru hija ortografija oħra ta' fosforu.
usage_examples.text_en: Fosfru is another spelling of fosforu.

definitions.text_mt: Fost: Fl-ambjent jew fin-nofs ta' grupp ta' nies jew affarijiet.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa kien l-aktar għaqli fost ħutu.
usage_examples.text_en: He was the wisest among his siblings.

usage_examples.text_mt: Fost l-affarijiet l-oħra, għandna bżonn naħsbu dwar il-baġit.
usage_examples.text_en: Among other things, we need to think about the budget.

usage_examples.text_mt: Hemm qbil fost l-istudjużi dwar dan il-punt.
usage_examples.text_en: There is agreement among scholars on this point.

definitions.text_mt: Fotografija: Arti jew proċess li jipproduċi stampi billi jirreġistra d-dawl fuq materjal sensittiv.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fotografija hija l-passat tiegħu mill-aktar żgħir.
usage_examples.text_en: Photography has been his passion since childhood.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fotografija diġitali bidlet il-mod kif inwettqu l-istampi.
usage_examples.text_en: Digital photography changed the way we take pictures.

definitions.text_mt: Fotografiku: Relatat mal-fotografija jew użat fil-fotografija.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa xtara tagħmir fotografiku ġdid għall-istudjo tiegħu.
usage_examples.text_en: He bought new photographic equipment for his studio.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-memorja fotografika tagħha hija impressjonanti.
usage_examples.text_en: Her photographic memory is impressive.

definitions.text_mt: Fotografu: Persuna li tieħu ritratti bħala professjoni jew arti.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fotografu qabad mument indimentikabbli biż-żwieġ.
usage_examples.text_en: The photographer captured an unforgettable moment at the wedding.

usage_examples.text_mt: Bosta fotografu jużaw dawl naturali għar-ritratti tagħhom.
usage_examples.text_en: Many photographers use natural light for their portraits.

definitions.text_mt: Fotta: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd billi jqabbdu jemmen xi ħaġa falza.
Fotta: Jagħmel ħsara jew jeqred xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.text_mt: Fottieh billi qallu li l-karozza kienet tiswa inqas milli kienet tiswa verament.
usage_examples.text_en: He cheated him by telling him the car was worth less than it really was.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jekk tkompli hekk, se tfotta l-magna kollha.
usage_examples.text_en: If you keep going like that, you will ruin the entire engine.

definitions.text_mt: Fottafesti: Ortografija alternattiva ta' fottifesti.

usage_examples.text_mt: M'għandniex ikollna fottafesti magħna llum il-lejl — taf kif dejjem itejjeb il-burdata.
usage_examples.text_en: We should not have a killjoy with us tonight — you know how he always ruins the mood.

definitions.text_mt: Fottifesti: Persuna li tfixkel il-gost jew il-ferħ ta' ħaddieħor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tkunx fottifesti; ejja mal-ħbieb għall-parti!
usage_examples.text_en: Do not be a killjoy; come with your friends to the party!

usage_examples.text_mt: Fottifesti huwa dak li dejjem isib xi ħaġa x'jikkritika.
usage_examples.text_en: A killjoy is someone who always finds something to criticise.

definitions.text_mt: Foxxna: Għodda bil-ponta li tintuża għas-sajd taħt il-baħar, magħmula minn arblu bi snien bil-ponta.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bugħaddas uża l-foxxna għall-kaċċa taħt il-baħar.
usage_examples.text_en: The diver used a harpoon for underwater hunting.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-foxxna tradizzjonali kienet tintuża mis-sajjieda Maltin.
usage_examples.text_en: The traditional trident was used by Maltese fishermen.

definitions.text_mt: Foġġa: Stil jew drawwa popolari f'perjodu partikolari, speċjalment fl-ilbies jew fl-arredament.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-foġġa tal-lum hija differenti ħafna minn dik ta' għaxar snin ilu.
usage_examples.text_en: Today's fashion is very different from that of ten years ago.

usage_examples.text_mt: Hija libset libsa ta' l-aħħar foġġa.
usage_examples.text_en: She wore a dress of the latest fashion.

definitions.text_mt: Foħħar: Oġġetti magħmula mit-tafal maħruq, bħal brieret, platti u vażuni.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-foħħar Malti huwa magħruf għad-disinni tradizzjonali tiegħu.
usage_examples.text_en: Maltese pottery is known for its traditional designs.

usage_examples.text_mt: Hija tiġbor vażuni tal-foħħar minn madwar id-dinja.
usage_examples.text_en: She collects pottery vases from around the world.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fuħħar kien jintuża mill-qedem biex jaħżnu l-ilma u ż-żejt.
usage_examples.text_en: Pottery was used since ancient times to store water and oil.

definitions.text_mt: Fqajjar: Kemmxejn fqir.

definitions.text_en: poor in a way that evokes sympathy
definitions.text_mt: Fqajjar: Li jqanqal simpatija minħabba l-faqar tiegħu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fqajjar raġel tilef kollox fin-nar.
usage_examples.text_en: The poor man lost everything in the fire.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tħallix lil dak it-tifel fqajjar waħdu.
usage_examples.text_en: Do not leave that poor little boy alone.

definitions.text_mt: Fqar: Għamla plural ta' fqir.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dawk huma l-fqar tar-raħal.
usage_examples.text_en: Those are the poor people of the village.

definitions.text_mt: Fqar: Jitlef il-ġid jew ir-riżorsi finanzjarji tiegħu u jsir fqir.

usage_examples.text_mt: Wara li tilfu n-negozju, huma fqru għalkollox.
usage_examples.text_en: After they lost the business, they became completely poor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ir-raħal intefa' kollu fqar wara n-nixfa.
usage_examples.text_en: The whole village became poor after the drought.

definitions.text_mt: Fqir: Li m'għandux biżżejjed flus jew riżorsi materjali jew li għandu mezzi finanzjarji limitati.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa raġel fqir li jgħix b'pensjoni żgħira.
usage_examples.text_en: He is a poor man living on a small pension.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fqir kellu jitlob l-għajnuna mingħand il-ġirien.
usage_examples.text_en: The poor man had to ask for help from the neighbours.

usage_examples.text_mt: Minkejja li kien fqir, kien dejjem ġeneruż ma' ħaddieħor.
usage_examples.text_en: Despite being poor, he was always generous with others.

definitions.text_mt: Fqis: Il-proċess ta' meta l-għasafar jew ir-rettili joħorġu mill-bajda, jiġifieri t-tfaqqis.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fqis tal-bajd isir wara madwar tnax-il jum.
usage_examples.text_en: The hatching of the eggs occurs after about twelve days.

usage_examples.text_mt: Matul il-fqis, l-għasafar omm jibqgħu fil-bejta.
usage_examples.text_en: During hatching, the mother birds stay in the nest.

definitions.text_en: brother (member of a religious community or church)
definitions.text_mt: Fra: Membru ta' komunità reliġjuża maskili (ortografija alternattiva ta' fratell).

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fra kien jgħix fil-kunvent tul ħajtu kollha.
usage_examples.text_en: The brother lived in the convent his entire life.

definitions.text_mt: Fra-servjent: Għasfur (Himantopus himantopus) b'saqajn twal u roża u ġisem abjad u iswed (ortografija alternattiva ta' fras-servjent).

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-fra-servjent jgħix qalb l-imraġ u l-għadajjar.
usage_examples.text_en: The black-winged stilt lives among marshes and ponds.

usage_examples.text_mt: Rajt fra-servjent jiekol ħdejn l-għadira l-bieraħ.
usage_examples.text_en: I saw a black-winged stilt feeding near the pond yesterday.

definitions.text_mt: Frabika: Bini fejn isiru prodotti bil-makkinarju (ortografija alternattiva ta' fabbrika).

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-frabika l-qadima ngħalqet sentejn ilu.
usage_examples.text_en: The old factory closed two years ago.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ħafna ħaddiema tilfu xogħolhom meta l-frabika għalqet.
usage_examples.text_en: Many workers lost their jobs when the factory closed.

definitions.text_en: diminutive of firjol: a small violet flower found in the Maltese countryside
definitions.text_mt: Frajjel: Fjura żgħira ta' lewn vjola li tikber fis-swali Maltin (tifkira ta' firjol).

usage_examples.text_mt: Sibt frajjel sabiħ fil-kampanja llum filgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: I found a beautiful little violet flower in the countryside this morning.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-frajjel jikber fis-swali Maltin fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.text_en: The small violet flower grows in Maltese valleys in spring.

definitions.text_en: diminutive of firjol: a small violet flower found in the Maltese countryside
definitions.text_mt: Frajwel: Fjura żgħira ta' lewn vjola li tikber fis-swali Maltin (tifkira ta' firjol).

usage_examples.text_mt: Frajwel huwa fjura żgħira sabiħa li tinsab fl-għelieqi.
usage_examples.text_en: A frajwel is a pretty little flower found in the fields.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tfal ġabru l-frajwel għall-ġnien tal-iskola.
usage_examples.text_en: The children collected small violet flowers for the school garden.

definitions.text_mt: Frak: Ammont żgħir, daqsxejn.
Frak: Sa ċertu punt, kemmxejn.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa frak aktar għaqli minn ħuh.
usage_examples.text_en: He is a little bit wiser than his brother.

usage_examples.text_mt: Stenna frak ieħor sakemm nasal.
usage_examples.text_en: Wait a little bit longer until I arrive.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ħalib huwa frak sħun wisq; ħallih jiksaħ.
usage_examples.text_en: The milk is somewhat too hot; let it cool down.

definitions.text_mt: Frak: Biċċa żgħira ta' ikel niexef, speċjalment ħobż jew kejk, li tkun waqgħet minn biċċa akbar.
Frak: Ammont żgħir ħafna ta' xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.text_mt: Waħħalni, waqgħatli ftit frak ta' ħobż fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.text_en: Sorry, a few breadcrumbs fell on the table.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ma kienx hemm frak ta' ikel x'nieklu.
usage_examples.text_en: There was not a crumb of food to eat.

usage_examples.text_mt: Frak ta' fortuna huwa aħjar minn xejn.
usage_examples.text_en: A small amount of fortune is better than nothing.

definitions.text_mt: Frakass: Ħoss qawwi u konfuż, storbju qawwi li jfixkel is-skiet.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-frakass fit-toroq ma ħalliex lil ħadd jorqod.
usage_examples.text_en: The noise in the streets did not let anyone sleep.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-frakass tal-magna kien jinstema' minn kmieni.
usage_examples.text_en: The noise of the machinery could be heard from far away.
